thread:
sarah_sales: FYI - Saffron POC just pushed back. CISO flagged SOC2 KMS/BYOK controls and wants explicit commitments + pricing concessions to proceed this quarter. We need an exec bridge. @ivan_se can you summarize what we can realistically promise for a POC?

ivan_se: Short summary: we support BYOK on Private and Dedicated. Hosted API does NOT support customer-managed HSM BYOK today — we have a KMS proxy for key wrapping but keys live in our KMS. For Dedicated we can plug in customer KMS (Azure/AWS/GCP) with some infra work (~2 weeks if prioritized). For POC the fastest path is a Dedicated pilot with BYOK; otherwise compensating controls for hosted.

mira_security: The SOC2 ask references: HSM-backed keys, rotation policy, separation of duties, and audit trails. We can provide detailed doc + audit extracts. HSM-backed BYOK in Hosted is a no-go for short timeline. Options: 1) Dedicated pilot + BYOK, 2) Hosted POC + compensating controls + attestations, 3) provide temporary escrow-style keys (not preferred). Recommend exec bridge with their CISO to set expectations.

luis_ae: Customer will likely request a pricing concession if we lock into Dedicated for the POC (they asked about 30% off committed run for 6 months). What are our flexible levers here — credits, trial capacity, price protection?

vp_sales_julia: We can use credits + a limited-time pilot discount but need Product signoff for any SLA or BYOK guarantees. @kate_engineering can you give a quick lift estimate and whether we can hit 2-week timeline?

kate_engineering: If we freeze scope (no extra integrations), engineering + infra can deliver customer-KMS support for Dedicated as a pilot: estimate ~10 dev-days + ops runbook. If we front-load work and devs focus, I can see a 10–14 business day turnaround. Need clear acceptance test and a small permeability plan for rollout.

sarah_sales: Can we support an exec call tomorrow 9am PT? Customer asked for executive presence (CISO + Head of Platform). I can get them to accept that slot if we confirm attendees.

vp_sales_julia: I can join the call. I want a 1-pager we can present that covers: supported BYOK modes, timeline, compensating controls, and proposed commercial concession.

mira_security: I'll draft the 1-pager with explicit answers to the SOC2 items (HSM support, key rotation cadence, audit log samples) and include the acceptable BYOK configurations. Will have a draft by EOD today.

ivan_se: One more technical note: POC token throughput limits might be an issue for their workload. Recommend we bump quota to 5k tpm for the pilot. @devops_bot can you open a quota ticket/pre-approve?

devops_bot: Quota request logged: INC-8721. Auto-response: pending manual approval from infra-oncall.

kate_engineering: I'll prepare an infra PR template and runbook snippets to attach to the 1-pager; will stand by to create the Dedicated cluster and KMS integration once we have the green light.

sarah_sales: Great — I'll schedule the bridge and add the draft SOC2 Qs to the invite. Please @mention if you need me to loop legal or solutions engineering. :thumbsup:

luis_ae: Can Sales ops prepare a simple commercial proposal we can show on the call (pilot credit + price protection)? I can draft but would like a ballpark from finance.

vp_sales_julia: I'll ask finance for a pilot credit range (targeting ~20–30% effective discount) and get back before the call. If Security and Eng can confirm the Dedicated pilot path, we can proceed.

sarah_sales: Thanks team — next actions: Mira 1-pager (EOD), Kate infra runbook + PR template, Ivan confirm token bump path, VP Sales confirm commercial range. I'll post bridge invite once we have names.

mira_security: Noted. I'll attach the SOC2 checklist mapping to our controls in the doc.
